1722-2034-3583-6823.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card.
1722-2034-3583-6823.description:
Draw a card.
Nadir Kraken triggers, causing you to pay {1} to put a +1/+1 counter on it and create a 1/1 Tentacle creature token.
When the Tentacle enters, Aunt May triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Oloro triggers. Holding prioirty, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Tentacle, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Oloro trigger, causing you to pay {1} to draw a card and cause each opponent to lose 1 life.
Repeat.

3490-5477-7075-7175.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature token that has not been tapped this turn.
3490-5477-7075-7175.description:
Activate a creature token by tapping it, adding {1}.
The creature's ability granted to it by Tale of Katara and Toph triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the creature.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Repeat.

765-1479-3604.description:
Create a nonlegendary copy of Kodama of the East Tree using Cadric (this may involve additional steps depending on the card used).
Play Guildless Commons.
When Guildless Commons enters, both Kodama of the East Trees and Guildless Commons trigger.
Resolve the nonlegendary Kodama of the East Tree trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Guildless Commons trigger, returning it to your hand.
Resolve the legendary Kodama of the East Tree trigger, putting Guildless Commons onto the battlefield.
The nonlegendary Kodama of the East Tree and Guildless Commons trigger.
Resolve the Guildless Commons trigger, returning it to your hand.
Resolve the nonlegendary Kodama of the East Tree's trigger, putting Guildless Commons onto the battlefield.
The legendary Kodama of the East Tree and Guildless Commons trigger.
Repeat from step 5.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Radiant Solar
as a copy of Radiant Solar

670-1619-3122-6558.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
You are not currently venturing in a dungeon.
670-1619-3122-6558.description:
Put any nontoken creature onto the battlefield.
When the creature enters, Radiant Solar, Undercover Operative and Naga Fleshcrafter each trigger.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, causing you to venture into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Undercover Operative trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Radiant Solar.
Resolve the Naga Fleshcrafter trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Radiant Solar from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
670-1619-3122-6558.notes: If you are currently venturing in a dungeon when starting the combo, you can complete the dungeon and then use Sefris' second ability to put a creature onto the battlefield to start the combo.

1251-5477-7686.notablePrerequisites: You control four or more Squirrels.
1251-5477-7686.description:
Activate The Unbeatable Squirrel Girl by paying {1}{G}{G}{G}, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token for each Squirrel you control.
Activate four Squirrels by tapping them, adding {1}{G}{G}{G}.
Repeat
1251-5477-7686.notes: You'll create double as many Squirrels each loop. All Squirrels beyond the first four will be untapped and can be used to add additional mana.

240-4452-6797.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies as an Egg due to Rukarumel, Atla triggers, revealing a creature card from your library and putting it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Repeat as desired / able.
240-4452-6797.notes: The combo can continue as long as there are creature cards in your library.

1765-2440-7060-7109.description:
Cast Trusty Boomerang by paying {1}.
When Trusty Boomerang enters, Chishiro's triggers, creating a 2/2 Spirit creature token.
When the Spirit enters, Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C} for each Spirit you control.
Activate Trusty Boomerang's equip ability by paying {1}, attaching it to the Spirit token.
Activate the Spirit by paying {1} and tapping it, tapping a creature and returning Trusty Boomerang from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
1765-2440-7060-7109.notes: The cost can be reduced if you control more Spirits.

1802-3011-7186.easyPrerequisites: Each opponent's life total is 2 or greater.
1802-3011-7186.description:
Cast Gideon's Sacrifice by paying {W}.
Activate Heartless Hidetsugu by tapping it, dealing damage to each opponent equal to half their life total, rounded down, times 2, and dealing no damage to you due to Gideon's Sacrifice.
1802-3011-7186.notes: If the opponents have an odd life total, they will have 1 life remaining. If they have an even life total, they will have 0 life and lose the game.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with Mirror Room locked and Fractured Realm unlocked

1115-5475-5921-5970.description:
Activate Marina by tapping it, unlocking Mirror Room.
Mirror Room triggers twice due to Fractured Realm, creating two token copies of Forensic Researcher.
Activate one of the Forensic Researcher tokens by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Activate Marina by tapping it, locking Mirror Room.
Activate the other Forensic Researcher token by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Repeat.

2511-3703-7084.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Sporemound triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Repeat.

3532-4997-5078-6709.easyPrerequisites: Ballad of the Black Flag's fourth chapter ability has triggered this turn
3532-4997-5078-6709.notablePrerequisites: You control another Knight and/or Merfolk.
3532-4997-5078-6709.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Vodalian Wave-Knight triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each other Knight and/or Merfolk you control.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Repeat.

2292-4186-6872.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to put a +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak
2292-4186-6872.description:
Put a +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Long Feng triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat from step 3.

2421-3705-4050-4985.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Squee and Skyfire Phoenix, adding {R}{R}.
Cast Squee from your graveyard by paying {R}{R}.
Skyfire Phoenix triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

104-3197-6458.easyPrerequisites:
Thunder of Unity's second or third chapter ability has triggered this turn.
You have a way to gain life.
104-3197-6458.description:
Gain life.
Cleric Class triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth.
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Thunder of Unity triggers, causing you to gain 2 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

413-654-2608-2882-6644.manaNeeded: {G}{W}{U} plus an additional {1} if you've cast Derevi from the command zone this game
413-654-2608-2882-6644.description:
If you haven't cast Derevi from the command zone this game, cast it by paying {G}{W}{U}. Otherwise, activate Derevi by paying {1}{G}{W}{U}, putting it from the command zone onto the battlefield.
Derevi enters the battlefield as a copy of Ancient Adamantoise due to Infinite Reflection. When it enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Derevi.
Choose to return Derevi from your graveyard to the command zone.
When Derevi dies, it triggers, creating ten tapped Treasure tokens.
When the Treasures enter the battlefield, Amulet of Vigor triggers that many times, untapping the Treasures.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability.
Activate four Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{G}{W}{U}.
Repeat.

141-3967-6475.description:
Cast Reunion of the House by paying {5}{W}{W}.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying {2}{U}{U}.
When Naru Meha enters the battlefield, it triggers, targeting Reunion of the House.
Holding priority, activate Yahenni by sacrificing Naru Meha.
Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, copying Reunion of the House, targeting Naru Meha and any other creature(s) as desired.
Resolve the copy of Reunion of the House, returning the targeted creatures from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

2060-4565-4893-5140.description:
Activate Kenrith by paying {G}, putting two +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler.
Activate Crystalline Crawler by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {G}.
Repeat.
2060-4565-4893-5140.notes:
You may place additional counters on Crystalline Crawler to get infinite mana, and then use that mana to activate Kenrith's abilities.
Once you have infinite mana, you may spend it on Kenrith's other abilities.

2538-3139-3661-3676.description:
Cast Shield Sphere by paying {0}.
Tangleroot triggers, adding {G}.
When Shield Sphere enters the battlefield, The Great Henge triggers.
Holding priority, activate Words of Wind by paying {1}, replacing the next card you draw.
Resolve the The Great Henge trigger, causing you to return Shield Sphere from the battlefield to your hand, and causing each opponent to return a permanent they control from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

1339-2811-4279.notablePrerequisites:
Your life total is at least 2.
You control at least one additional creature.
1339-2811-4279.description:
Activate Yawgmoth's first ability by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Elas il-Kor's second ability triggers, causing each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, causing you to draw a card and allowing you to put a -1/-1 counter on up to one creature.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
When the Insect enters the battlefield, Elas il-Kor's first ability triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat.

2525-2947-5147.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Body Double.
When Body Double leaves the battlefield, its Vesperlark ability triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Vesperlark.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Repeat.

4455-5641.notablePrerequisites:
Basking Broodscale does not have a +1/+1 counter on it.
Ghost Lantern attached to Basking Broodscale.
4455-5641.description:
Activate Basking Broodscale's adapt ability by paying {1}{G}, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
When the Eldrazi Spawn dies, Ghost Lantern triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Basking Broodscale.
Repeat from step 2.

3260-3540-4030-4740.notablePrerequisites:
"Enchantment" chosen with Cloud Key.
Your life total is at least nine if your storm count is equal to zero, at least six if your storm count is equal to one, at least four if your storm count is equal to two, or at least three otherwise.
3260-3540-4030-4740.description:
Cast Mourning by paying 2 life, targeting K'rrik.
Aetherflux Reservoir and K'rrik trigger.
Resolve the K'rrik trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Aetherflux Reservoir trigger, causing you to gain an amount of life equal to your storm count.
Resolve Mourning, attaching it to K'rrik.
Activate Mourning by paying 2 life, returning it to your hand from the battlefield.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite life, you may use Aetherflux Reservoir's ability to deal infinite damage to any target(s).

900-1550-2239-2481.notablePrerequisites:
Sword of Hearth and Home and Sword of Feast and Famine attached to any other creature without summoning sickness.
Lands you control can tap to produce at least {3}{R}.
An opponent is unable to block and kill the creature with the Swords attached.
900-1550-2239-2481.description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent using the creature with Sword of Hearth and Home attached.
Sword of Hearth and Home and Sword of Feast and Famine trigger.
Resolve the Sword of Hearth and Home trigger, blinking Ardent Elementalist and causing you to search your library for a basic land card and put it onto the battlefield.
Ardent Elementalist enters the battlefield, returning Seize the Day from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Sword of Feast and Famine trigger, causing you to untap all lands you control, and causing the defending player to discard a card.
Move to your postcombat main phase.
Activate any number of lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {3}{R}.
Cast Seize the Day by paying {3}{R}, causing you to untap the creature with Sword of Hearth and Home attached and to get an additional combat and main phase after this one.
 Repeat.

1657-2355-4050.notablePrerequisites: Murderous Redcap does not have any -1/-1 counters on it on it.
1657-2355-4050.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Murderous Redcap, adding one mana of any color.
Murderous Redcap's persist ability triggers, returning itself to the battlefield.
Anafenza and Murderous Redcap trigger.
Resolve the Anafenza trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on Murderous Redcap.
Resolve the Murderous Redcap trigger, dealing damage equal to its power to any target.
Repeat.

1719-3230-4222.notablePrerequisites:
Vizier of Tumbling Sands does not have summoning sickness.
Freed from the Real attached to Vizier of Tumbling Sands.
1719-3230-4222.description:
Activate Coral Atoll by tapping it, adding {C}{U}.
Activate Vizier of Tumbling Sands by tapping it, untapping Coral Atoll.
Activate Freed from the Real's last ability by paying {U}, untapping Vizier of Tumbling Sands.
Repeat any number of times.
